text:
Aisha Patel: FYI — Adrian Kapoor (adrian.k) submitted resignation today. Last day is 2025-02-14 (Fri) EOD. He’s remote (DE) and has a company laptop, JetBrains/Slack/Atlassian seats, VPN, and a couple of service keys. Can we coordinate a clear offboard window and owners? :wave:
Kevin Morris: Sad to see him go. Confirming last day. I’ll handle knowledge transfer and repo handoff. Need GitHub org owner transfer before deprovision.
Aisha Patel: Thanks Kevin — can you own GitHub + Jira ownership transfer?
Kevin Morris: Yep. I’ll transfer repo owners by 02/13 and add replacement reviewer.
Sam Liu: @Aisha @Kevin I can do device pickup + MDM wipe. Will need laptop serial and preferred carrier. I can also schedule Okta deprovision. Propose deprovision at 2025-02-15 12:00 UTC (4h after payroll cutoff). Sound OK?
Aisha Patel: Sounds good. Adrian is in CET, timezone note. Please aim for EOD+4h UTC to give manager a buffer.
Sam Liu: Got it. Please DM me serial. Also: will revoke GCP service account keys at the same time unless Kevin flags owners.
Lisa Gómez: Security asks for list of any long-lived tokens (deploy keys, third-party integrations). Also confirm VPN account name. We prefer token revocation simultaneous with Okta disable. :lock:
Kevin Morris: Adrian uses one deploy key (ci-adrian-key) and a team GCP SA (team-gen-ai-sa). I’ll rotate ownership for the SA to myself by 02/13 and remove the deploy key once transfer complete.
Omar Khan: Finance — is Adrian on payroll or contractor final invoice? Need his last pay period and any expense reimbursements by payroll cutoff. If contractor, we’ll need final invoice by 02/10.
Aisha Patel: Adrian is FT (Germany). So payroll, not contractor. Maria, can you confirm benefits/insurance end date and local process?
Maria Santos: Confirmed — for DE employees we stop company health contributions end of last day (02/14). COBRA is US-only, not applicable. We’ll provide a benefits termination letter and contacts for local insurance. I’ll schedule the exit call and send opt-out/continuation options where relevant.
Maria Santos: I’ll also book a 30-min exit interview with Adrian for 02/14 10:00 CET — tentative, invite sent.
Aisha Patel: Can we capture timeline in checklist? Posting quick offboard plan below — update inline when each item is done.
Aisha Patel: ```Offboard checklist (Adrian Kapoor) - Last day: 2025-02-14
- Knowledge handoff: Kevin (due 02/13)
- Repo/Jira ownership transfer: Kevin (done by 02/13)
- Laptop return + MDM wipe: Sam (pickup arranged by 02/15)
- Okta + VPN disable: Sam (scheduled 02/15 12:00 UTC)
- Service keys/token revocation: Lisa & Kevin (02/15 12:00 UTC)
- Benefits & termination letter: Maria (send 02/12)
- Final payroll reconciliation: Omar (confirm by payroll cutoff 02/14)
- Exit interview: Maria (02/14 10:00 CET)
- License seat releases (Slack/Atlassian/JetBrains): Kevin (confirm by 02/15)
```
Sam Liu: Quick note: for remote shipping I can provide a prepaid label. If Adrian prefers drop-off, he can return to our Berlin partner location.
Kevin Morris: Will remove Atlassian license and reassign Slack seat after 02/14 EOD. Leaving Slack admin intact until after GitHub/Jira ownership transfer.
Lisa Gómez: Security will run a final access audit 02/15 12:00 UTC and confirm revocations. Please put any exceptional tokens in this thread if they should be excluded.
DevOps Bot: Okta disable job queued for user adrian.k at 2745682200 (scheduled).
Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone — if you pick up an item, please reply with "OWNED" and update the checklist. I’ll follow up with the final confirmation once all checks are complete. :white_check_mark:
